common: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single WorldSim construction-state sprite. Transparent background, no ground plane, cast shadow, text, labels, border, or cropped object. References 1 and 2 are locked style anchors props.png and scene.png; reference 3 is the precise built-state design to preserve. Fine warm brown-black ink over quiet earth-colour wash, broad base plus distinct darker right/lower shadow tone. Outer contours twice secondary lines. Wood has 3 broken longitudinal marks per principal pole; clay 3 short crack groups; stone 3 facet/crack groups; straw 5 bundle marks. One parallel / hatching group of3, no dense all-over hatching. Strong common light upper-left; top and left surfaces lighter, right/lower faces darker. Camera front three-quarter about20 degrees down, horizontal base, orthogonal world geometry, not isometric. Neolithic: no metal, no dyed cloth, no people. Draw a single whole object with ample transparent margin, source shapes recognizable at game scale.
